title: Intense and very relaxing massage
text:
A gift from my partner and it has been a very good experience. The Masseuse did a good intense job from the feet, back and head. In addition, you can choose an oil when entering to make the scrub. I ended up very relaxed and calm.
I really loved it. Highly recommended:-)

text: The place is very relaxing, a real oasis in the middle of the city. It was a gift but I'm sure I'll repeat it. If you are in the area, reserve your time for yourself. You'll love it.

title: Excellent!! I'll be back!
text: A wonderful experience from start to finish. The massage was incredibly relaxing and professional, with attention to detail really making a difference. In addition, the treatment of the team was exceptional: friendly, attentive and with a great positive energy. Undoubtedly, a place that I will return to and that I totally recommend to those who seek a moment of well-being and disconnection
